doc: float64 directions at the places that break a lookup: the poles (lat clamps to the first and last row; lon of the exact pole is arctan2(0, 0) = 0), the antimeridian (-1, 0, 0) and (-1, -0.0, 0): fx = -0.5 or W - 0.5, both average the last and first columns and give the SAME value (x0 % W wraps a negative index to W - 1: floor modulo, not truncation), the +-y axes, directions that are not unit length (lon is scale free, but lat = arcsin(clip(z)) uses z as is and clips |z| > 1), points 1e-9 either side of the antimeridian, and 75 random unit directions. The image is 8x16 float32; output float64: rtol 1e-9.
